svg.text: Bag End and the Long-expected Party
Frodo is wounded; the Riders close in
Aragorn carries the company to Rivendell
▸ one lane leaves the bus and does not come back
eight lanes, still side by side
the widest the company ever is
STRANDS — label size follows strand width
hatched lane = off-page, still in the story
The Fellowship of the Ring — eleven strands, vertically
Time runs down the page; each lane is one character. Row spacing follows the film's own runtime, so the gaps are data.
Where lanes sit side by side, they are travelling together. The nine-walker bus forms at Rivendell and shatters at Amon Hen.
Label size follows ribbon width — it is a rough measure of presence in the film, not of worth.
